meta.name: ai-traffic
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "track AI traffic" or "track ChatGPT/Perplexity referrals"; isolates AI-assistant referral sessions in GA4/GSC/server logs and reports their trend, landing pages, and conversion vs organic. Not for keyword positions — use rank-tracker; not for multi-metric stakeholder reports — use performance-reporter. AI流量/AI引荐/ChatGPT流量/AI转化

copy.tagline: 追踪AI引荐流量来源与转化效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想知道ChatGPT等AI工具给你带来了多少访问和转化
copy.tagline_en: Track AI referral traffic and conversion performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know how much traffic and conversions ChatGPT and other AI tools bring you

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会从你的 GA4、Search Console 或服务器日志中分离出 AI 助手（如 ChatGPT、Perplexity）带来的流量，并报告其趋势、着陆页以及与自然搜索的转化对比。
howto.when: 当你要求“追踪 AI 流量”或“追踪 ChatGPT/Perplexity 引荐”，或询问 AI 流量、AI 引荐、AI 渠道组、AI 与自然搜索转化对比时触发。

say.text: 追踪 example.com 过去 90 天的 AI 引荐流量。
say.note: Claude 会分析 AI 渠道的会话趋势和着陆页。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude isolates AI-assistant referral sessions (ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) from your GA4, Search Console, or server logs, and reports their trend, top landing pages, and conversion vs organic.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "track AI traffic" or "track ChatGPT/Perplexity referrals", or inquire about AI traffic, AI referrals, AI channel group, or AI vs organic conversion.

say_en.text: Track AI referral traffic for example.com over the last 90 days.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze AI channel session trends and landing pages.

say_en.text: How much of my traffic comes from ChatGPT and Perplexity, and does it convert better than organic?
say_en.note: Claude will compare AI channel conversion rate to organic.
